segments.title: Lear RAG agent — recorded agent sessions
text: Run lear-rec-20261106T1219Z · recorded 2026-11-06 UTC · branch arena/c2d86cd7-rag-formation
Every terminal segment is a genuine asciinema recording of the existing agent's CLI
(python3 -m ragformation lear ...). Each is shown at its real speed first, then as a paced
replay of the same recording that only pauses for reading (the banner says which).
Ollama is BLOCKED in this environment (not installed; model hosts unreachable).
NO answer in this film comes from an LLM. Answers come from the labelled baseline:
hashing embeddings + extractive synthesis, which selects and cites corpus sentences.
Cards like this one are editorial. Failures and an aborted attempt are kept, not cut.
